message:
As a grandparent, I often find myself reflecting on how prepared my grandchildren are for everyday situations. It’s fascinating to see the world through their eyes, where even the simplest tasks can feel daunting. I recently came across a resource that highlights some essential safety skills everyone should know, and I think it’s a wonderful way to engage with our little ones. Teaching them these skills not only empowers them but also strengthens our bond as they feel more capable and confident. 

Have you chatted with your kids about safety lately? It might be a fun conversation starter.
